_backfill_note: Historical reconstruction on 2026-05-15. Sunday — W16 reflective beat + W17 agenda-setting. (1) TechCrunch 'OpenAI's existential questions' Equity podcast + companion piece — surveys Anthropic enterprise share lead, TBPN media acquisition, Hiro personal-finance buyout, strategic ambiguity between consumer flywheel + enterprise platform reset; positions GPT-5.5 (Thu 23 Apr) + Deployment Company (11 May) as make-or-break for the enterprise narrative. (2) Anthropic Haiku 3 retirement — last day for $0.25/$1.25 budget model; Anthropic deliberately cedes ultra-low-cost segment to Mistral Small / Llama / DeepSeek; Haiku 4.5 at $1/$5 becomes cheapest in the lineup. (3) Claude Design Sunday weekend follow-on: MindStudio + Get AI Perks + BuildFast With AI converge on Pro/Max bundling (50M+ Claude subs vs Figma's ~13M paid seats) as consensus moat; design-tooling category re-pricing settles as Q2 defining 'AI disintermediation' story. (4) Snowflake AI Pulse pre-event analyst notes for Tue 21 Apr — multi-agent Cortex extensions + ServiceNow/Workday connectors + Gemini 3 Cortex availability; second beat in the 'control plane for the agentic enterprise' narrative. (5) Matt Webb 'Headless everything for personal AI' (annotated by Willison) — headless services become default because personal AIs prefer APIs to GUIs; Salesforce Headless 360 as reference implementation; Brandur Leach 'Second Wave of the API-first Economy' as policy frame; per-seat SaaS pricing collapse is implied conclusion. Research (Sun backfill, Friday cohort, deduped vs 04-17/04-18): Mnemonic Sovereignty memory-governance survey, SafeDream proactive jailbreak detection 1.0-1.2 turns before compliance, SuperLocalMemory V3.3 biologically-inspired on-device memory, TESSY teacher-student SFT, Cyber Defense Benchmark (3.8% recall reality check), MASS-RAG role-specialised, Agent-World scaling environment synthesis, MCPThreatHive automated MCP threat intelligence, Single-Agent-Beats-Multi-Agent on multi-hop reasoning under equal budgets. STAGE MOVES: none — Sunday consolidates W16; W17 anchors come into view.
